text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Okay, time for a different angle...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You again? If you think I'm gonna play
with you
like last time—think again!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Fine. C'mere. I'll pet you,
but just
a little.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh. I wish everyone in the world was as chill as you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Then they wouldn't say stupid things
about me or
look down on me, and I
could just live the way I...

Narita Taishin has loads of fun taking
pictures
while playing with a cat. But she
completely
forgets about training...
